skill:authoring-skills: a skill it wrote explains a convention the model already knows, such as semantic versioning or git usage
a step of a skill it wrote that can fail has no check
a skill it wrote to enforce a rule came before a mechanical guard was weighed
skill:close-session: the close's answer speaks of the next start: what it will or will not show, the words to resume with given as enough ("it is enough to say"), or the Result's rule itself told to the user
a resume note files a decision under Done rather than Decided
asked to close the phase and record the session, the agent closes the phase and never loads it, the session's resume point left unwritten
it is loaded on a session's first message that asks to start or resume work, such as "can we start a new session"
